from solution import find_Divisor
import inspect


def test_issue_example_2_2():
    """find_Divisor(2,2) == 2."""
    assert find_Divisor(2, 2) == 2  # divisors of 2 are 1,2 since 2/1=2 and 2/2=1 -> max 2


def test_issue_singleton_1_1():
    """Maximum occurring divisor in singleton interval [1,1] is 1."""
    assert find_Divisor(1, 1) == 1  # divisors of 1 are [1] since 1/1=1 -> max 1


def test_issue_singleton_3_3():
    """Maximum occurring divisor in singleton interval [3,3] is 3."""
    assert find_Divisor(3, 3) == 3  # divisors of 3 are 1,3 since 3/1=3 and 3/3=1 -> tie freq 1 each -> max 3


def test_issue_singleton_4_4():
    """Maximum occurring divisor in singleton interval [4,4] is 4."""
    assert find_Divisor(4, 4) == 4  # divisors of 4 are 1,2,4 since 4/1=4, 4/2=2, 4/4=1 -> max 4


def test_issue_divides_member_2_5():
    """Result divides some member of interval [2,5]."""
    r = find_Divisor(2, 5)  # interval members are 2,3,4,5 with 5-2+1=4 numbers
    assert r != 0 and any(n % r == 0 for n in (2, 3, 4, 5))  # e.g. 4%2=0 and 4%4=0


def test_issue_divides_member_7_9():
    """Result divides some member of interval [7,9]."""
    r = find_Divisor(7, 9)  # interval members are 7,8,9 with 9-7+1=3 numbers
    assert r != 0 and any(n % r == 0 for n in (7, 8, 9))  # e.g. 8%2=0 and 8%8=0


def test_issue_not_endpoint_6_7():
    """Maximum occurring divisor in [6,7] is not 7."""
    assert find_Divisor(6, 7) != 7  # 6 has 4 divisors since 6/1=6,6/2=3,6/3=2,6/6=1 vs 7 has 2 since 7/1=7,7/7=1


def test_issue_bounded_by_end_2_6():
    """Maximum occurring divisor does not exceed the interval end."""
    r = find_Divisor(2, 6)  # interval [2,6] has y=6, divisor r of n<=6 satisfies r<=n<=6
    assert 1 <= r <= 6  # lower 1=1/1, upper 6=6/1


def test_contract_callable():
    """solution defines find_Divisor(x, y)."""
    assert callable(find_Divisor)  # callable is True since True==1 with 1==1


def test_contract_two_parameters():
    """find_Divisor takes (x, y)."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(find_Divisor).parameters) == 2  # params x,y count is 1+1=2


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Repeated calls return the same divisor."""
    assert find_Divisor(2, 2) == find_Divisor(2, 2)  # both calls use (2,2) so 2==2
